breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L − x) and integrates it over the bar length using δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx. It does not collapse the distributed self-weight into a single concentrated end load, and makes no claim that such a simplification is exact. This matches the ground truth approach and eliminates the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt.
